info.name: CHP folder tags
info.summary: Tag every file that arrives in a configured team folder (CUI, FCI) with that folder's system tag.
info.description: Spike (ISO 0.7.0 Plan 1): rules = app config chp_foldertag/rules, JSON {"team folder id": system tag id}. occ chp:foldertag:check lists untagged files.
info.author: CyberHygiene Project
